title: Book 9 — Calliope, Chapter 35
paragraphs: Just so the Spartans too, being in great need of Tisamenos, agreed to whatever terms he demanded. And once the Spartans had agreed to this demand as well, then Tisamenos the Eleian, now a Spartan, shared with them in winning five of the greatest contests as their diviner; and these were the only men ever made fellow citizens of the Spartans. The five contests were these: first, this one at Plataea; after this, the battle at Tegea against the Tegeans and Argives; then the contest at Dipaieis against all the Arcadians except the Mantineians; after that, the contest with the Messenians at Ithome; and last of all, the contest at Tanagra against the Athenians and Argives. This, I say, was accomplished last of the five contests.
